title: Cart Legends - Free Playtest Update 0.1.0
author: ProudAd3678
selftext:
Hello,

It's been a while since I showed this project, but I struggled a lot to optimize it without compromising the modularity and damage of the carts. There is still a lot to be done, for sure. I want to push the architecture even further when it comes to performance, because breaking the cart and recalculating the remaining structure takes twice the physics simulation time per tick, and this is really bad, but I managed to have an enjoyable build which I would say is worth some testing time. Even with AI, this was a really tough challenge. It took a lot of measurements, tests, profiling, and architectural planning, and even rewriting some parts of Jolt and the Godot engine. It turns out AI alone is really bad at optimizing any kind of application, so I am not sure why people say we are close to AGI. The number of times I had to intervene and change its direction was insane.

I added a "report a bug" system. There's a Discord channel to join if you are interested in following the project or contributing with ideas, criticism, or whatever!

There are still a lot of placeholder assets everywhere. There is a lot of work to be done regarding the aesthetics of the game, but I wanted to focus on actually having a playable game before investing more time in this direction. The friends who work with me on this project will slowly replace the generated assets. "Slowly" because we are not giving AI the artistic direction of the game. This is a passion of theirs and I want to support it, not replace it. However, as a pre-AI developer, I can't say the same about my passion. I couldn't be happier to become an architect instead of being a programmer, even if this skill will probably fade out in time. It will be replaced with something that I personally like more: architectural design knowledge and creativity.

If this looks good to you, please give it a try. It's FREE (and it will stay like this for a long time as I develop it). I am thinking of giving the game for free at release to the people who joined early, but that is too early to think about for sure, as currently there are just the three people behind the project and two other curious people making up the player count.

If you took the time to read this, thank you, and maybe we'll have some races or fights together!
